extension.summary: Shows the Red Light Autoplay Next Episode popup with dummy details.
extension.description: Opens the Autoplay Next Episode popup with dummy show and episode details, so its style can be checked without playing an episode. The buttons only close the popup, and Back or Escape also closes it. Does not need Red Light.
extension.news: 1.0.10: Play is back to 200 px wide. The Play Now text box and the icon box are wider, so the text is no longer cut off on a TV. 1.0.9: The Play button is 230 px wide, 20 px wider, and its ends keep their full curve. 1.0.8: The card sits 24 px from the right edge and 23 px from the bottom, closer to the screen edges. The Play button is 210 px wide, and its ends keep their full curve. 1.0.7: The popup is a card in the Seren Lucent style, 774 x 268 px, 32 px from the right edge and 31 px from the bottom. The heading reads NEXT EPISODE IN with the countdown, then the season and episode and the show title. The Play button is 200 px wide with its icon, and Cancel is 140 px wide. The thumbnail has 17 px corners and the card has 32 px corners. 1.0.6: The popup sits 2 px higher again. 1.0.5: The popup sits 10 px further left and 2 px higher, so it clears the right edge of a TV. The outline is a little lighter and the shadow is a little more transparent. 1.0.4: The thumbnail sits in the left column with 12 px rounded corners, and the countdown and buttons sit in the right column. The season premiere or finale banner shows on the thumbnail. The popup is 542 px wide and 148 px tall. 1.0.3: The popup is 602 px wide and 108 px tall, with 30 px padding on the left and right. The shadow and panel follow the new size. 1.0.2: The add-on icon has a new file name, so Kodi shows the Autoplay icon on every device. No other changes. 1.0.1: Opens over a demo background image. The popup has the new layout, 20 px corners, a 1.5 px outline and a drop shadow. The icon is an Autoplay button. 1.0.0: First release. Shows Red Light's Autoplay Next Episode popup with dummy details.
